name: lookup_account_balance_v2
description: Log in with the given username and password, open Accounts Overview, and read the balance of account {{account_id}} into an output named balance

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open Accounts Overview, and read the balance of account {{account_id}} into an output named balance

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password using the Customer Login form
steps.action: Locate the username input [e9] and password input [e10] on the entry page, enter the username and password respectively, then click the Log In button [e11].
After successful login, find and click the 'Accounts Overview' link in the post-login navigation menu.

steps.intent: Read the balance of the specified account
steps.action: On the Accounts Overview page, locate the row corresponding to account_id and read the balance value from that row, storing it as the output named 'balance'.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to the banking application

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to the banking application

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account number whose balance should be read from the Accounts Overview page

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed, showing a table of accounts with their balances, and a row matching account_id is present on the page.

hardening_rejected: s05_extract: detector 'det_account_not_found' rejected: 'Accounts Overview' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to the banking application

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: The account number whose balance should be read from the Accounts Overview page

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to the banking application

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; a currency amount, returned as a number

business_outcomes.description: The username or password supplied was not accepted by ParaBank. The login attempt was rejected.
The requested account_id does not appear in the authenticated user's Accounts Overview. No balance can be returned.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: Login failed: the supplied username or password was rejected by ParaBank.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank reported an internal server error during login. Cannot proceed.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

on_exhausted.message: No row matching account_id {{account_id}} was found in the Accounts Overview table. The account may not belong to this user.

candidates.rationale: row anchored by first cell text, for id-less legacy tables

success.description: Page state proving success: The "Accounts Overview" heading is the fixed page title that appears on every successful login and account listing page in ParaBank. It is structural page state, not a data value, so it remains stable across all runs regardless of account balances or user data.
